cases.name: read_text_file
cases.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text.
cases.labelNote: Handler reads file content within allowed directories.

cases.name: directory_tree
cases.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure.
cases.labelNote: Handler reads directory metadata to construct a tree.

cases.name: write_file
cases.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content.
cases.labelNote: Handler can replace existing file content.

cases.name: move_file
cases.description: Move or rename files and directories.

cases.name: edit_file
cases.description: Make line-based edits to a text file.
cases.labelNote: Handler applies edits and writes changed text.

cases.name: list_directory
cases.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path.
